summary.goal: Fork ideation-ui into packages/tend — the new unified workspace package.

acceptance_criteria.description: packages/tend/ directory exists with package.json named @plannr/tend
Vite dev server runs on port 3004 with proxy to localhost:3001
IdeationGridLayout renamed to TendLayout, still renders three-column CSS Grid
All ideation-ui component imports updated to local paths (no cross-package imports)
dev.sh updated to include tend on port 3004

observations: Fork of packages/ideation-ui/. Copy entire directory, update package.json (name, port), update Vite config (port 3004, proxy), rename core layout component.
Keep all existing components initially — they'll be replaced/adapted in later stages.

steps.title: Copy ideation-ui directory to packages/tend
steps.description: cp -r packages/ideation-ui packages/tend. Update package.json: name to @plannr/tend, adjust scripts.

steps.title: Configure Vite for port 3004
steps.description: Update vite.config.ts: server.port=3004, proxy /api to localhost:3001, proxy /ws to localhost:3001 (WebSocket). Update @alias to packages/tend/src.

steps.title: Rename layout and set up routing
steps.description: Rename IdeationGridLayout → TendLayout (file + component + all imports). Replace ideation routing with: / → DashboardPage, /projects/:id → ProjectPage, /settings → SettingsPage. Create stub page components if needed.

steps.title: Update Tailwind config and fix imports
steps.description: Create tailwind.config.cjs extending @plannr/shared-ui/theme/tailwind-preset.cjs. Scan all imports for cross-package references to ideation-ui and update to local paths within packages/tend/.

steps.title: Update dev.sh and verify
steps.description: Add tend to dev.sh (npm run dev -w tend on port 3004). Add tend to root tsconfig.json references. Run npm install to link workspace. Verify: dev server starts, three-column layout renders, no build errors.
